title: Restlessness that learns to dwell
subtitle: For the search that must stop feeding on motion
description: These readings separate holy seeking from agitation and teach the mind to dwell where mercy, sangat, and Naam can actually work on it.

heroSource.shortMeaning: Wandering ceases when the heart comes to dwell in saintly company and receives mercy’s light.
heroSource.lifeApplication: Let the search land somewhere true long enough to be changed.

evidence.coreClaim: This journey moves restlessness from motion into dwelling.
evidence.turn: The mind becomes teachable when it stops treating movement as proof of life.
evidence.practicalImplication: Remain with one chosen practice today after the impulse to switch appears.
